title: Check HMI visibility and activity/system active error evidence for a stuck AGV or stuck task
summary: Use this incident-derived diagnostic when bag-out or related flow issues may involve a stuck task or AGV inactivity and the needed screen is not visible in Aveva. The incident evidence supports checking alternate visibility paths: reviewing system activity or system active error information for an AGV that has not moved for an extended period, and checking the site HMI for a stuck-task error that may only be visible there.
when_to_use: Use when troubleshooting a bag-out or related AGV/task issue at the incident site and Aveva does not show the needed screen or visibility is otherwise limited. This runbook is appropriate for gathering diagnostic evidence about whether an AGV has been inactive for an extended period or whether a stuck-task error is visible only on the HMI.
not_for: Do not use this as a recovery procedure for clearing a stuck task; the incident references the need for a recovery process but does not provide one.
Do not use this to make undocumented configuration, HMI deployment, or AGV recovery changes.
Do not use this when exact navigation or controls are required beyond what is shown in the incident evidence.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Review Aveva visibility, inspect system activity or system active error information, inspect the site HMI, and compare findings to determine whether evidence supports a stuck-task or AGV inactivity hypothesis.

safety_notes: This source supports inspection and interpretation only; it does not support performing recovery actions.
If the needed HMI visibility is unavailable because the latest HMI project has not been pushed or the error cannot be seen, stop and escalate rather than making undocumented changes.
Do not perform undocumented recovery changes based only on suspicion.

steps.purpose: Determine whether normal Aveva visibility is available or whether alternate evidence sources must be used.
steps.instruction: Check whether the relevant troubleshooting screen can be seen in Aveva. If the screen is not visible, continue with alternate checks using system activity or system active error information and the site HMI.

steps.healthy_condition: The relevant screen is visible in Aveva and can be reviewed.
